checks.name: Cook statement and ops finance/configuration component tests
Customer web and mobile sources contain no commission or service-fee wording

scenarios.observed: ZeroCommissionIntegrationTest on PostgreSQL: a launch order (2 x 12000 + delivery 3000) quotes 27000 with no platform fee, stores commission snapshot 0|0, completes through the real cook commands and posts a ledger group whose entries sum to 0; the cook statement shows commissionPosted and commissionOutstanding 0. A policy change with commissionRateBps 1000 is refused 422 (value.commissionRateBps RANGE_0_0) while 0 is accepted; a direct insert of a live (non-synthetic) policy with commission 1000 is refused by the database check. The development policy is 0%. Cook statement and ops finance show 'لا توجد عمولة للمنصة' and no commission rows or column when nothing is owed; the configuration view says 'no platform commission'. Customer web and mobile have no commission or service-fee wording. Native apps were not re-run for this story: they never displayed commission (source check above).

findings: D10 zero commission at 07d7236. Self-review, not independent review. The dormant commission arithmetic stays covered only by synthetic test fixtures.
